The gap

Christians

Why it matters

“Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect.”

1 Peter 3:15, Berean Standard Bible

How it works

A safe place to practice.

STEP 1

Pick a hard question

Sixteen questions in eight topics, from suffering to other faiths.

STEP 2

Talk it through

Five turns with an AI skeptic. Ask Coach if you get stuck.

STEP 3

Read a short review

What you covered, what to add, and a verse. No scores.

Meet the cast

Three AI roles, one purpose: practice.

The skeptic

Asks the hard question and pushes back on your actual answer.

CuriousHostileBalanced

Coach

Helps in steps, so you find your own words first.

Hint→Outline→Sample

The review

Written to you after five turns. Encouraging, specific, never graded.

Built in on purpose

Safeguards

Always labeled AIThe skeptic says it's simulated if you ask.
No fake conversionsThe skeptic never claims to be converted.
RespectfulNever insults you or your faith.
Care in a crisisStops the exercise and points to real help.
One checked verseNo invented books, quotes or statistics.
No scores, no accountsConversations stay in your browser.

Under the hood

How the AI is used

You

  • Any phone or computer
  • No account
  • Saved in your browser

Our server sets the rules

  • Five turns per talk
  • Separate instructions for each role
  • One checked verse per question
  • A daily limit on live use

Apologist Project AI platform

  • Plays the skeptic
  • Powers Coach and the review
  • Memory off: nothing carried over

Who it's for

Anyone who wants to be ready.

Small groups

Practice the same question, then talk about it together.

Students

Rehearse before the questions come at school.

New believers

Find words for faith that's still new.

Church leaders

Print a conversation to use in training.
